messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into Bulgarian, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE Bulgarian line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.
Когато видях този човек в голямата пустиня, Помилуй ме виках към него, Какъвто и да си, дали си сянка или истински мъж.

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG/GRAMMAR/UNNECESSARY] Mark GRAMMAR for agreement errors (gender, number, case) or other grammatical mistakes. Mark UNNECESSARY for elements present in source but not needed in target language (e.g., articles that target language omits naturally). After the table, list any MISSING, WRONG, GRAMMAR, or UNNECESSARY items.

**Word‑to‑Word Mapping Table**
| Source Word | Contextual Definition | Target Word/Phrase | Back‑Translation | Status | |-------------|-----------------------|--------------------|-------------------|--------| | Quando | temporal conjunction “when” | Когато | “when” | OK | | vidi | verb, past “saw” | видях | “saw” | OK | | costui | demonstrative pronoun “him” | този човек | “this man / him” | OK | | nel | preposition “in” | в | “in” | OK | | gran | adjective “great” | голямата | “the great” | OK | | diserto | noun “desert” | пустиня | “desert” | OK | | Miserere | imperative “have pity” | Помилуй | “have pity” | OK | | di | preposition “on” | — | — | UNNECESSARY | | me | pronoun “me” | ме | “me” | OK | | gridi | verb, past “cried” | виках | “cried” | OK | | a | preposition “to” | към | “to” | OK | | lui | pronoun “him” | него | “him” | OK | | qual | relative pronoun “whatever” | Какъвто | “whatever” | OK | | che | relative particle (connects) | — | — | UNNECESSARY | | tu | pronoun “you” | — | — | UNNECESSARY | | sii | subjunctive “are” | си | “are” | OK | | od *(first)* | conjunction “or” | дали | “whether” | **WRONG** | | ombra | noun “shade” | сянка | “shade” | OK | | od *(second)* | conjunction “or” | или | “or” | OK | | omo | noun “man” | мъж | “man” | OK | | certo | adjective “real / certain” | истински | “real / certain” | OK |
---
### Items Requiring Attention - **WRONG**: *od* (first occurrence) – rendered as **дали** (“whether”), which does not match the source conjunction “or”. The appropriate Bulgarian equivalent would be **или**. - **UNNECESSARY**: *di*, *che*, *tu* – these elements have no separate lexical counterpart in Bulgarian and are naturally omitted.
No **MISSING**, **GRAMMAR**, or other **UNNECESSARY** items were detected.

### Step 4: Correction & Final Output Fix any MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR items from Step 3. Reorder within line if needed; do not add new content words. Verify that the output contains only Bulgarian script; no other language scripts should be mixed in. Output format (use nested bullet list, not table): - Line N: - Original: ... - Issue: ... (or "none") - Corrected: ... (or "no change") Output final Bulgarian text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).

- **Line 64**: - Original: *Quando vidi costui nel gran diserto,* - Issue: none - Corrected: *Когато видях този човек в голямата пустиня,*
- **Line 65**: - Original: *«Miserere di me», gridai a lui,* - Issue: none - Corrected: *Помилуй ме виках към него,*
- **Line 66**: - Original: *«qual che tu sii, od ombra od omo certo!».* - Issue: **WRONG** – first “od” rendered as “дали” instead of the conjunction “или”. - Corrected: *Какъвто и да си, или сянка или истински мъж.*
